vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability exists in the swapTokens function. It calls swapTokensForEth which uses Uniswap router to swap tokens for ETH. When ETH is sent to the contract, the receive() function is triggered. The marketingAccumulator is only reset to 0 AFTER the swap completes. An attacker can reenter the contract during the ETH transfer and trigger another swapTokens call, causing the same marketingAccumulator balance to be swapped multiple times.
attack_strategy: 1. Deploy a malicious contract that implements a receive() function to reenter the NOMOS contract. 2. Accumulate marketing fees by making token transfers to build up marketingAccumulator. 3. Trigger swapAndLiquify by selling tokens to the pair. 4. During the ETH transfer in swapTokensForEth, reenter and call transfer() to trigger another swapTokens call before marketingAccumulator is reset.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Create an attacker contract with a receive() function that reenters NOMOS. 2. Get some NOMOS tokens (deal them). 3. Ensure swapAndLiquifyEnabled is true (call afterPreSale as owner). 4. Build up marketingAccumulator by making transfers. 5. Trigger the swap by selling tokens to the pair. 6. In receive(), call transfer() again to reenter before marketingAccumulator is reset. 7. Profit from multiple ETH transfers.
